decisions.reason: The batch count does not change the established CJ source, import action, or product-selection criteria.
The spreadsheet already records all TikTok Shop listings; the current batch count does not change its tracking rules or layout.
Adding all 15 products does not change their temporary category or the rule for later final categorization.
The existing rule already publishes each product when it is added to the list; the batch count changes volume, not Shopify publication behavior.
TikTok listing coverage is already all products, so specifying that the current batch contains 15 products does not change the listing requirement.
The source concerns a product-processing batch and does not affect daily social-media content publishing.
The product batch count does not alter the content-bank deliverable.
The source decision is unrelated to the Pinterest Task 2 deliverable.
